title.rendered: I Am the Light of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness.” A morning devotional on the light Jesus brings to every dark room of the human heart.

content.rendered:
Every year at the Feast of Tabernacles, four massive golden menorahs were lit in the Jerusalem Temple. When the feast ended, the wicks were extinguished. Jesus stood there in the fading glow and said, “I am the light of the world.” The real light had never been the lampstands.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, August 22, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, ‘I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life.'”
John 8:12 (NKJV)

Today’s Message

Every year, on the first evening of the Feast of Tabernacles, four massive golden menorahs were lit in the Court of the Women at the Jerusalem Temple. Each stood over seventy feet tall. Their wicks were fashioned from the worn-out garments of the priests. When the flames were kindled, ancient rabbinic sources tell us, the light was so intense that every courtyard in Jerusalem was illuminated. Rabbis danced in the light with flaming torches. The Levites played harps and cymbals on the fifteen steps between the courts. For seven nights the whole city glowed.

Then the feast ended. The wicks were extinguished. The menorahs went dark. The Court of the Women returned to its ordinary evening dimness. It was in that setting, most likely in that very court, with the extinguished menorahs still visible around Him, that Jesus spoke one of the most breathtaking sentences of His entire earthly ministry. “I am the light of the world. He who follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life.” The ceremonial light of the Temple had just been put out. And Jesus was standing there saying, “The real light did not go out. The real light is standing in front of you.”

The Passion Translation renders it: “Jesus said to the people, ‘I am light to the world and those who embrace me will experience life-giving light, and they will never walk in darkness'” (John 8:12 TPT). The Amplified Bible Classic Edition adds: “I am the Light of the world. He who follows Me will not be walking in the dark, but will have the Light which is Life” (John 8:12 AMPC). The Light which is Life. Not light plus life. Not light and then life. The light is the life. To have Christ is to have both, together, forever.

The Greek phrase Jesus uses is again ego eimi, the burning-bush I AM of Exodus 3. Jesus is not saying He carries light or reflects light or witnesses to light. He is claiming to be the light. Not a lamp. Not a candle. Not a torch someone else lit. The Light itself, standing in the Court of the Women that evening in bodily form. The One by whom all things were made, and without whom nothing that has been made was made, was standing there, quietly, personally, telling any who would listen that the light they had been reaching for through torches and rituals and lampstands had a face and a name and was inviting them to follow.

For Gospelbuzz readers today, the sentence still holds. Wherever you are reading this from, in Lagos or London or Manila or Nairobi or Sao Paulo, whatever darkness has been walking with you, whatever confusion has been clouding your steps, whatever shadow the enemy has been trying to cast over your thinking, the Light of the World is inviting you to follow. The verb tense matters. He does not say those who admire the light. He does not say those who study the light. He says those who follow the light. The light moves. The light leads. The light is a Person you walk behind, not a doctrine you contemplate. Follow Him today. The darkness does not have to follow you any longer. The Light of Life has come.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that Jesus is the Light of the World. He is the Light of my life today. Whatever darkness has been surrounding me, whatever confusion has been clouding my steps, whatever shadow the enemy has been casting over my thinking, I refuse to walk in it. I follow the Light. I walk in the Light which is Life. In Him is no darkness at all. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

Jesus is the Light of the World. I follow Him today. Whatever darkness surrounds me is smaller than the Light who leads me. I walk in the Light of Life.
